file_impact.reason: Provision a blobless single-branch clone of main as the code root alongside the tickets clone, backgrounded so it cannot block exec past the readiness deadline
Set REBAR_ROOT to the code clone so the gate ops resolve refs against a real repository instead of the /app source copy

mcp_run_new must set the same REBAR_ROOT and mount, keeping blue-green containers at parity with the compose service; plus the AC5 readiness check that refuses to promote a container whose code root cannot resolve the base ref
Executable coverage: the code root is provisioned and resolvable, a failure surfaces rather than being reported as success, and the compose/autodeploy env stay in parity
